id_search_sms.description: Search SMS in the ID region within a customer account and time window, PII masked by default. the cloud data warehouse-backed. This proc is account- and timeframe-SCOPED: AccountUid, UserId, and a TimeframeStart/TimeframeEnd window are ALL required (bounds the query and enforces access) — it is NOT a global by-UMID lookup. To narrow to one message, also pass UMID. For a pure single-message lookup by UMID alone (no account/timeframe), use the direct msg.MessageLog_GetByUmid tool (see config/dab-config.pending.json) once deployed. Decode result codes: StatusId 10-level model 0=UNKNOWN,10=RECEIVED,11=SCHEDULED,20=PROCESSED/SENT,21=REJECTED BY APPDB(final),30=DELIVERED TO CARRIER,31=REJECTED BY CARRIER(final),40=DELIVERED TO DEVICE(final/success),41=REJECTED BY DEVICE(final),50=READ(final). SmsTypeId 0=MO,1=MT,2=RCS_MO,3=RCS_MT_TEXT,4=RCS_MT_MEDIA. Region-local (AppDb_Data), vetted SP — not raw msg.MessageLog access.

parameters.name: AccountUid
parameters.description: Customer account to search within (uniqueidentifier / GUID). REQUIRED — the proc is account-scoped.

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description: Portal user id (uniqueidentifier / GUID) whose accessible sub-accounts scope the results (via core.fnSubAccount_GetByUser). REQUIRED. NOTE: an Ops/Eng caller must supply a UserId that has access to the account, or results are empty — confirm the intended value for non-portal callers.

parameters.name: TimeframeStart
parameters.description: Start of the search window (UTC datetime, ISO 8601). REQUIRED. Keep the window tight around the expected message time — this is a the cloud data warehouse scan.

parameters.name: TimeframeEnd
parameters.description: End of the search window (UTC datetime, ISO 8601). REQUIRED.

parameters.name: UMID
parameters.description: Optional: narrow to a single message by its unique message id (uniqueidentifier / GUID).

parameters.name: MSISDN
parameters.description: Optional destination number filter (digits only, E.164 without +).

parameters.name: MaskSensitiveData
parameters.description: Mask PII (destination last-4, redact body). Defaults to true here; the underlying SP defaults to UNMASKED, so keep true unless explicitly authorized.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Max rows to return (SP caps apply).

id_lookup_sms_region_by_umid.description: Resolve which region a UMID belongs to in the ID region (fast router lookup; returns RegionName only, no message body). Use this first when you don't yet know where a message lives. Region-local (AppDb_Data).

parameters.name: Umid
parameters.description: Unique message id (uniqueidentifier / GUID) to resolve. Provide this for the normal lookup path.

parameters.name: ConnUid
parameters.description: Alternate key (connection uid); the SP requires it but ignores it when Umid is set, so a dummy 0 is passed.

parameters.name: CorrelationId
parameters.description: Alternate key (connector message id); the SP requires it but ignores it when Umid is set, so an empty string is passed.
